grammarFocus: 名词性从句入门；that 从句；情态动词与条件表达。
title: Smart Speaker, Smart Choices?
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习，主题为科技、隐私与观点组织。请先听录音（或阅读录音稿），然后回答10个问题。问题类型包括单选、填空、匹配和判断正误/未提及。所有答案均来自录音内容。注意：本材料为模拟练习，并非官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look worried. What's up?
Ben: Oh, hi Mia. It's my new smart speaker. I think it's listening to me all the time.
Mia: Really? Why do you think that?
Ben: Well, yesterday I was talking about buying a new bike, and then I saw ads for bikes on my phone. That can't be a coincidence.
Mia: Hmm, that is strange. But maybe your phone and the speaker are connected? Do you use the same account?
Ben: Yes, I do. But I didn't say anything to my phone. I only talked to my friend in the kitchen, near the speaker.
Mia: I see. So you think the speaker heard your conversation and shared it with your phone?
Ben: Exactly. And that makes me uncomfortable. I mean, I know it's supposed to help me, but I don't like the idea that it might be recording everything.
Mia: I understand. But have you checked the privacy settings? Maybe you can turn off the microphone when you don't need it.
Ben: No, I haven't. I didn't know I could do that. Can you show me?
Mia: Sure. First, open the app on your phone. Then go to 'Settings' and find 'Privacy'. There should be an option to disable the microphone.
Ben: OK, let me try. ... Oh, I see it. It says 'Microphone: On'. I'll turn it off.
Mia: Good. Also, you might want to delete your voice recordings. The app probably stores them.
Ben: Right. I'll do that too. Thanks, Mia. You're a lifesaver.
Mia: No problem. But remember, if you turn off the microphone, you won't be able to use voice commands. You'll have to use the app instead.
Ben: That's fine. I'd rather have privacy than convenience.
Mia: That's a valid choice. Just be aware that some features won't work.
Ben: I understand. Thanks again.
Mia: You're welcome. Let me know if you need more help.

options: His smart speaker is listening to him all the time.
He can't connect to the internet.
answers: His smart speaker is listening to him all the time.
questions.explanation: Ben明确说“I think it's listening to me all the time.”，因此选A。
questions.evidence: I think it's listening to me all the time.

questions.prompt: Why does Ben think the speaker heard his conversation?
options: He saw ads for bikes after talking about buying a bike.
The speaker said hello to him.
He read it in the news.
answers: He saw ads for bikes after talking about buying a bike.
questions.explanation: Ben说昨天谈论买自行车后，手机上就看到了自行车广告，他认为这不是巧合。
questions.evidence: yesterday I was talking about buying a new bike, and then I saw ads for bikes on my phone.

questions.prompt: What does Mia suggest Ben should check?
questions.explanation: Mia问“have you checked the privacy settings?”，建议Ben检查隐私设置。
questions.evidence: have you checked the privacy settings?

questions.prompt: Ben says he will turn off the ______.
questions.explanation: Ben在对话中说“I'll turn it off.”，指代前文的microphone。
questions.evidence: It says 'Microphone: On'. I'll turn it off.

questions.prompt: What does Mia say Ben can do with his voice recordings?
questions.explanation: Mia说“you might want to delete your voice recordings.”，建议删除录音。
questions.evidence: you might want to delete your voice recordings.

questions.prompt: What will happen if Ben turns off the microphone?
options: He won't be able to use voice commands.
The speaker will stop working completely.
He will need to buy a new phone.
He will lose all his data.
answers: He won't be able to use voice commands.
questions.explanation: Mia提醒“if you turn off the microphone, you won't be able to use voice commands.”，因此选A。
questions.evidence: if you turn off the microphone, you won't be able to use voice commands.

questions.prompt: What is Ben's attitude towards privacy vs. convenience?
options: He thinks both are equally important.
questions.explanation: Ben说“I'd rather have privacy than convenience.”，表明他更看重隐私。
questions.evidence: I'd rather have privacy than convenience.

questions.prompt: What does Mia mean by 'That's a valid choice'?
options: She agrees that privacy is important.
She thinks Ben is making a mistake.
She wants to change the topic.
answers: She agrees that privacy is important.
questions.explanation: Mia说“That's a valid choice.”，表示她认可Ben的选择，即认为隐私重要。

questions.prompt: Where does Mia tell Ben to find the privacy settings?
questions.explanation: Mia指导Ben：“open the app on your phone. Then go to 'Settings' and find 'Privacy'.”，因此是在应用的设置菜单里。
questions.evidence: open the app on your phone. Then go to 'Settings' and find 'Privacy'.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Ben has already deleted his voice recordings.
questions.explanation: Ben说“I'll do that too.”，表示他将会删除，但还没做。因此“已经删除”是假的。

vocabulary.example: I'd rather have privacy than convenience.
There should be an option to disable the microphone.
you might want to delete your voice recordings.
I'd rather have privacy than convenience.

grammar.title: 名词性从句入门；that 从句；情态动词与条件表达
grammar.explanation: 名词性从句在句子中充当名词的角色，比如主语、宾语或表语。that 从句常用来表达想法、事实或信念，例如“I think that...”。情态动词如 can, might, should 表示能力、可能性或建议。条件表达常用 if 引导，表示“如果……就……”。
grammar.example: I think it's listening to me all the time.

options: I think that he is right.
I think that is he right.
I think that right he is.
answers: I think that he is right.
questions.explanation: that 从句用陈述语序，即“that + 主语 + 谓语”。
questions.evidence: I think it's listening to me all the time.

questions.prompt: If you turn off the microphone, you ______ use voice commands.
questions.explanation: if 条件句，主句用将来时，表示将来结果。
questions.evidence: if you turn off the microphone, you won't be able to use voice commands.

questions.prompt: She said that she ______ come to the party.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 might 后接动词原形。

questions.prompt: ______ he studies hard, he will pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 条件句用 if 引导，表示“如果”。
questions.evidence: if you turn off the microphone, you won't be able to use voice commands.
